Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I3, to be carried out every six months as indicated by M6 
in the title block.
The generator data: 277MVA, 15.75KV, 10.173KA, PF=0.8, 50HZ, 3000 rpm, Y connection
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Aziz El Bagoury, 
tested by eng. Enas Azmy and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Saad Bassuony, 
accepted by eng. Aly Abdel Wahab general director and approved by eng. Fathy 
Ragab head sector of Talkha PS.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality 
 control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general 
 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment.
The unit must be out of service.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete tool set
New brushes, Air blower, and Spray
Digital voltmeter, megger, clamp ammeter
Fine cloth and 
 brushes for cleaning purposes
Work to be carried out
Remove the brushes of generator and earthing brushes from their 
 holders.
Remove brush holders.
Measure the insulation resistance between slip ring and earth 
 by using megger device 500 Vdc, table (1).
Clean brushes slip ring contact.
After cleaning measure the insulation resistance between slip 
 ring and earth by using megger device 500 Vdc approximately ≥ 10 MΩ to be 
 sure the results of cleaning, as in table (1).
Change polarity of alternator.
Put holders in their position and tighten them.
Check the clearance between brushe holders and slip ring 
 approximately 3mm.
Check the protection device.
Measure the current in each brush and record it in table 2, if 
 the current in any brush less than 10 A, according to the recommendation from 
 specialist, replace it.
Measure the leakage AC voltage between 
 bearings of generator as in figure 1 approximately ≥ 2Vac
